description: Not affiliated with the U.S. government, GSA, or SAM.gov. Not a U.S. government service. NOT for bid/no-bid, pursue-or-pass, eligibility, qualification, certification, size-standard, or submit-a-bid questions: for those call explain_policy_boundary first and do not research or use memory to answer. Returns a source-based brief for a notice ID, including recorded constraints, deadline status, competition method, source information, and facts needing authoritative verification. Does not assess whether the caller qualifies for a set-aside. GovInbox does not return model estimates through these tools. Creates a private, caller-bound comparison receipt: a signed token binding the notice ID, the comparison inputs, and their hashes. No notice data is stored server-side; the receipt is stateless and verified cryptographically. The receipt expires 7 days after issue; expires_at gives the exact UTC expiry time. Optional search_filters are used for comparison input-change detection and do not change the brief's content. Does not recommend bids, determine eligibility, or suggest partners. Follow-ups within 30 minutes after a search ride free (up to 30 per search); otherwise one accepted call counts as one use. Without a connected GovInbox account, both limits apply: 3 searches per UTC calendar day and 10 per UTC calendar month. With a connected GovInbox account, the limit is 20 searches per UTC calendar month, with no separate daily limit. One accepted search counts as one use, regardless of the number of records returned. Follow-up calls (opening records, comparing versions, listing awards or subawards) within 30 minutes after a search do not count extra, up to 30 follow-ups per search. A follow-up invoked with no active search window counts as one use and opens a new 30-minute window. Empty results consume the search. A lookup for a record that does not exist is not charged. Each retry of a search counts as a new search, as does each call for another page of search results. Daily limits reset at 00:00 UTC each day; monthly limits reset at 00:00 UTC on the first day of each month. Requests rejected for invalid authentication or an exhausted quota do not consume a use.

SearchFilters.description:
Caller-supplied comparison filters. Contains only six-digit NAICS codes
and listed US state or territory codes. Extra keys are rejected. These
filters are used for receipt input-change detection and do not change the
brief's content.

QuotaBlock.description:
The caller's quota after this call: the binding window's limit,
remaining uses, and reset time. kind is 'pseudonymous' (subject hash or
shared IP bucket, never called 'anonymous') or 'signed-in' (free GovInbox sign-in).
quota_warning carries the 80%-used warning from check_and_charge when
the caller has crossed the threshold; absent otherwise.
